Bharat’s Auto-Ancillary Trinity: #SONACOMS × #BharatForge × #Motherson
(14th Oct 2025)
Three structural setups.
One macro story — Bharat’s engineering resurgence under the EV & manufacturing supercycle.

1️⃣ #SONACOMS – Double Bottom + Counter-Trendline Break Setup
A structural reversal forming at the intersection of Price, RSI & Fundamentals — with Auto-Ancillary tailwinds and EV megatrend support.

• Price has completed a clean Double Bottom — a textbook base before multi-month reversals.
• Verge of Counter-trendline breakout now in progress.
• RSI mirrors the same breakout attempt → dual alignment of Price + RSI.
• Sustained close above ₹480–₹500 = breakout confirmation → opens 50–65% upside toward ₹600+.
• Failure to hold can retest ₹380.

Not a random bounce — this is structural symmetry between Price & RSI.

Fundamentally:
– Market Cap ~₹27k Cr
– Q1FY26 Revenue ₹851 Cr (+14.7%) | Net Profit ₹122 Cr (+15.8%)
– Order Book ₹24,200 Cr (~77% EV)
– Debt/Equity ~0.1 | ROCE ~14% | ROE ~18%
– 60+ MFs added positions in Sep’25
A near debt-free EV leader with strong order visibility — fundamentals validate what charts whisper.

2️⃣ #BharatForge – Multi-Decadal Channel + RSI Positive Reversal (PR)
A 25-year geometry of expansion.
Price & momentum perfectly aligned inside a lifetime parallel channel.
• Price holding mid-channel near ₹1,200 above Fib 0.5–0.618 supports (₹992–₹905).
• RSI has printed Positive Reversal at 43–50 band — identical to 2013 setup that triggered a 400% rally.
• Sustaining RSI >55 confirms a new up-cycle.
• Fibonacci projections:
1.618 @ ₹1,579 → 2.618 @ ₹2,196 → 3.618 @ ₹2,841 (~129% potential).

🧭 BharatForge = precision + defence + EV pivot = industrial Bharat reborn.

Fundamentally:
– FY25 Revenue ₹14,100 Cr | EBITDA Margin ~17–18%
– Debt/Equity 0.23 | ROE ~17% | >50% exports
– Strong global order book + defence & EV diversification

3️⃣ #Motherson – Multi-Channel Convergence Setup
📎 Ref post 10th Sep 2025→ https://t.co/85husO2RER
From Mar’23 to Sep’24: #Nifty +50% | Motherson +250%.
That rally came from a 5-year base breakout.
The current bounce is a breakout retest across Q/M/W charts.
• Quarterly: Lifetime rising channel intact.
• Monthly: BO retest at 0.618–0.786 Fib band + RSI Positive Reversal.
• Weekly: Down-channel breaking; RSI reclaim 55–60 = ignition of next leg.

RSI law governs expansion far earlier than headlines.
Macro & Policy Tailwinds (2025–2030)
1️⃣ Auto-Ancillary re-rating → PLI transformation favors EV-focused suppliers.
2️⃣ GST 2.0 + festive demand = record domestic sales & OEM restocking.
3️⃣ Diversification & global footprint:
– SONACOMS → EV + Railway components (RED acquisition).
– BharatForge → Defence + EV drivetrain + Aerospace.
– Motherson → Global wiring + module leadership.
4️⃣ Policy megatrends → PLI + ACC = ₹25,000 Cr+ investments.
EV penetration goal 30% by 2030 → multi-decade runway.
5️⃣ De-risking China → Indian ancillaries gaining global share.

Risks:
US tariffs (50%) on components = near-term risk, long-term opportunity.
Rich valuations require delivery discipline.

Macro supports structure. Charts confirm strength. The confluence is rare.
The Power of Structural Confluence
Price Geometry (channel/base)
RSI Symmetry (PR/Breakout)
Fundamental Validation (EV, Defence, Global Exposure)
= Multi-cycle expansion.

I call it the “Three-Axis Confirmation”:
1️⃣ Structure (Price)
2️⃣ Energy (RSI)
3️⃣ Economics (Fundamentals)
→ When all three align, time becomes the fourth catalyst.

Triggers to Watch
• SONACOMS → Close >₹480–₹500 = confirmation
• BharatForge → RSI >55 + breakout >₹1,573 = trend ignition
• Motherson → Sustaining >₹105–₹110 = long-cycle continuation
• Macro → EV demand, new OEM contracts, policy flow
• Invalidations → SONA ₹380 / BHFORG ₹905 / MOTH ₹95

Peer Snapshot - I prefer stocks at bottom reversal or end of pullback.
BharatForge → Global & Defence Pivot
SONACOMS → EV drivetrain leader
Motherson → Scale & Global wiring leader
Endurance Tech → Steady compounder
Schaeffler → High precision, high valuation

Gita Reminder
“कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन”
Focus on karma (process, geometry, conviction) — not fruit (profit).
Dharma of a trader = process; fruit follows naturally.

My Differentiator
Others react after breakouts.
I map geometry before it unfolds — aligning Price, RSI & Macro in advance.

My Dharma: share truth before hype.
Your Dharma: amplify learning, not noise.
